cliff-terrace.description: Terraced marble retaining walls stepping up a cliff face: N tiers, each set back, with a moulded plinth, ashlar course joints, pilasters, blind arched niches with moulded surrounds, a string course, a paved coping and a stone baluster balustrade along each ledge. Front faces +Z. Box colliders per tier and per balustrade.
cliff-terrace.source: const W=params.width,H=params.height,T=Math.max(1,Math.round(params.tiers)),D=params.depth,S=params.setback;const th=H/T;const wallMat={finish:'stone',color:params.color,roughness:0.75,surface:{layers:[{kind:'tone',amount:0.3},{kind:'streaks',amount:0.4},{kind:'grime',amount:0.35},{kind:'edgeWear',amount:0.5},{kind:'moss',amount:0.25,mask:{up:0.6,noise:0.5}}]}};const trimMat={finish:'marble',color:params.trimColor,roughness:0.45,surface:{layers:[{kind:'veins',amount:0.1,scale:0.5},{kind:'grime',amount:0.2},{kind:'edgeWear',amount:0.6}]}};const nicheMat={finish:'stone',color:params.nicheColor,roughness:0.9};let wall=null,trim=null,niche=null,bal=null;function put(cur,m){return cur?cur.merge(m):m;}const prof=[[0.08,0],[0.08,0.06],[0.055,0.1],[0.095,0.3],[0.105,0.38],[0.065,0.5],[0.045,0.58],[0.075,0.64],[0.075,0.7]];const baluster=api.lathe(prof,8);for(let k=0;k<T;k++){const dk=D-k*S;const fz=D/2-k*S;const cz=fz-dk/2;const y0=k*th;wall=put(wall,api.box(W,th,dk).translate(0,y0+th/2,cz));wall=put(wall,api.box(W+0.2,0.6,0.22).translate(0,y0+0.3,fz+0.06));for(let c=1;0.6+c*0.9<th-0.5;c++){niche=put(niche,api.box(W-0.1,0.035,0.02).translate(0,y0+0.6+c*0.9,fz+0.006));}trim=put(trim,api.box(W+0.3,0.32,0.4).translate(0,y0+th-0.16,fz+0.1));trim=put(trim,api.box(W,0.12,dk).translate(0,y0+th+0.06,cz));const n=Math.max(2,Math.round(W/3)+1);const span=W-0.6;const bayW=span/(n-1);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const x=-span/2+i*bayW;trim=put(trim,api.box(0.55,th-0.9,0.24).translate(x,y0+0.6+(th-0.9)/2,fz+0.12));}for(let i=0;i<n-1;i++){const xm=-span/2+(i+0.5)*bayW;const nw=Math.max(0.5,(bayW-0.55)*0.55);const nh=Math.min(th*0.6,nw*2.3);const arch=[[-nw/2,0],[nw/2,0]];const seg=10;for(let s=0;s<=seg;s++){const a=Math.PI*s/seg;arch.push([Math.cos(a)*nw/2,nh-nw/2+Math.sin(a)*nw/2]);}const yb=y0+0.6+(th-0.9-nh)*0.45;trim=put(trim,api.extrude(arch,0.04).scale(1.18).translate(xm,yb-0.1,fz+0.02));niche=put(niche,api.extrude(arch,0.04).translate(xm,yb,fz+0.05));}const yb2=y0+th+0.12;const bz=fz-0.2;trim=put(trim,api.box(W,0.14,0.28).translate(0,yb2+0.07,bz));trim=put(trim,api.box(W+0.1,0.12,0.32).translate(0,yb2+0.9,bz));const nb=Math.max(2,Math.floor((W-0.4)/0.32));for(let b=0;b<=nb;b++){const x=-(W-0.4)/2+b*(W-0.4)/nb;bal=put(bal,baluster.clone().translate(x,yb2+0.14,bz));}trim=put(trim,api.box(0.36,0.96,0.36).translate(-W/2+0.2,yb2+0.48,bz));trim=put(trim,api.box(0.36,0.96,0.36).translate(W/2-0.2,yb2+0.48,bz));api.collider({kind:'box',halfExtents:[W/2,(th+0.12)/2,dk/2],offset:[0,y0+(th+0.12)/2,cz]});api.collider({kind:'box',halfExtents:[W/2,0.5,0.16],offset:[0,yb2+0.5,bz]});}api.add(wall,wallMat);api.add(trim,trimMat);api.add(niche,nicheMat);api.add(bal,trimMat);return api.build();

hero-statue.description: Classical marble statue, 2.8 m default. Plinth: base 0.9x0.2, step 0.75x0.15, die 0.6x0.5 with 0.4x0.12 inscription plate and 3 raised lines, cap 0.72x0.1 (top at 0.95). Figure on top: wide robe lathe hem r0.30 to waist 0.2 to shoulders 0.22 with 0.03-0.04 ring steps, sash tube across torso, drape rings hugging robe, feet at hem, arms r0.05 (left hanging with hand r0.045, right bent ~100deg raising a wreath R0.11), head r0.1 tilted 8deg with curl cap. White marble with grey veining vertex colours; mid-grey stone plinth.

marble-cliff-stair.description: Terraced cliff stair: niched retaining walls with pilasters and cornices stepping back up a cliff, zigzag marble flights as 1.4 m slabs on piers (open beneath), landings on piers, parapets and paved levels. Front tongue meets a lower flight.

marble-flight.description: Broad straight processional flight of marble steps rising toward -Z between sloping parapet walls with moulded coping and wreath reliefs, four pylons (two at the foot, two tall piers at the head) with cornices and bronze fire bowls of glowing coals. Walkable step colliders.

marble-grand-stair.description: Monumental switchback stair up a cliff: six stepped-back limestone retaining levels, each with a flight of real marble treads climbing along X on the shelf in front of the next level. Stringer walls carry sloped parapets with coping, piers at the flight ends, cornices and string courses, and landings with parapets. Local z 0 is the back (cliff side) and +Z the front. Same footprint as marble-terrace-stair.

marble-paving.description: Paved floor of separate ivory marble slabs with bevelled edges and slight height and tilt variation, set in a darker mortar bed; walkable box collider.

marble-stair-clean.description: Terraced switchback marble stair on a cliff face, with clean ivory finishes (no photo marble). Band 0 is a terrace with a central tongue where a processional flight arrives. Bands 1..tiers-1 carry stepped flights that alternate direction, with a landing at each end. Baluster railings run along every open edge. Retaining faces have a plinth, pilasters with capitals and a cornice, and the front face has arched niches. Walk colliders: blocks, landings, ramps under the steps, rails.

marble-stair-ivory.description: Terraced switchback marble stair on a cliff face: N tiers, each a band of stepped flights rising across the width with landings at both ends, ivory veined marble, baluster railings along every open edge, string courses and pilasters on the retaining faces, and a top platform. Walk colliders follow the flights.

marble-switchback-stair.description: Grand marble switchback stair climbing a cliff face: 8 flights alternating in two bands (z -23.5..-20.5 and -20.5..-17.5), landings at x ±5..9 on stone piers, balustrades on every flight and landing, a belvedere at the top bridging to the rim and a stone plinth at the foot. Built in world coordinates: place at [0,-4.5,-20.5].

marble-terrace-stair.description: Monumental switchback stair climbing a cliff as stacked terraces: six broad marble flights alternating left/right, each in front of a stepped-back limestone retaining wall, with solid parapets, end landings and a top landing level with the rim. Local z 0 is the back (cliff side), front is +Z.

marble-zigzag-stair.description: Grand marble switchback stair: 6 flights (14 m runs) alternating between a front band (z 0..3) and a back band (z -3..0), landings at x +-7..11.5 on tall stone piers, marble balustrades on every flight and landing, sloped walkable box colliders. Local y 0 = foot level; a 1.5 m pad below sets the base. Bbox symmetric in x and z.
marble-zigzag-stair.source: const col = params.color || '#f1ece2'; const pcol = params.pierColor || '#ddd5c4'; const top = params.top || 45.65; const marble = {preset:'stone', finish:'marble', color:col, roughness:0.42}; const railM = {preset:'stone', finish:'marble', color:api.mix(col,'#ffffff',0.3), roughness:0.4}; const pierM = {preset:'stone', finish:'stone', color:pcol, roughness:0.85}; const nF = 6, X0 = -7, X1 = 7, run = X1 - X0; const R = top / nF; const nS = Math.max(8, Math.round(R / 0.3)); const sr = R / nS, sx = run / nS; const L = Math.sqrt(run*run + R*R); const th = Math.atan2(R, run); const ang = th * 180 / Math.PI; const sn = Math.sin(th), cs = Math.cos(th); const LX0 = 7, LX1 = 11.5, PX = 10.2; function bx(w,h,d,x,y,z,m){ api.add(api.box(w,h,d).translate(x,y,z), m); } function cb(hx,hy,hz,x,y,z,rz){ api.collider({kind:'box', halfExtents:[hx,hy,hz], offset:[x,y,z], rotation:[0,0,rz]}); } function railX(cx,len,y,z){ bx(len,0.3,0.28,cx,y+0.15,z,railM); bx(len,0.12,0.26,cx,y+1.0,z,railM); const nb=Math.max(2,Math.round(len/1.4)); for(let k=0;k<nb;k++){ bx(0.14,0.66,0.14,cx-len/2+(k+0.5)*len/nb,y+0.62,z,railM);} cb(len/2,0.6,0.12,cx,y+0.6,z,0); } function railZ(x,cz,len,y){ bx(0.28,0.3,len,x,y+0.15,cz,railM); bx(0.26,0.12,len,x,y+1.0,cz,railM); const nb=Math.max(2,Math.round(len/1.4)); for(let k=0;k<nb;k++){ bx(0.14,0.66,0.14,x,y+0.62,cz-len/2+(k+0.5)*len/nb,railM);} cb(0.12,0.6,len/2,x,y+0.6,cz,0); } bx(24,1.5,6,0,-0.75,0,pierM); cb(12,0.75,3,0,-0.75,0,0); for (let f=0; f<nF; f++){ const front = f%2===0; const zc = front?1.5:-1.5; const dir = front?1:-1; const xs = front?X0:X1; const y0=f*R; for(let i=0;i<nS;i++){ const hh=sr+0.06; bx(sx+0.02,hh,3,xs+dir*(i+0.5)*sx, y0+(i+1)*sr-hh/2, zc, marble); } const nx=-sn*dir, ny=cs, my=y0+R/2, rz=dir*ang, ly=my+sr*0.5; api.add(api.box(L,1,3).rotate(0,0,rz).translate(-nx*0.5, my-ny*0.5, zc), marble); cb(L/2,0.5,1.5,-nx*0.5, ly-ny*0.5, zc, rz); for (let s=-1; s<=1; s+=2){ const zr=zc+s*1.35; api.add(api.box(L,0.3,0.28).rotate(0,0,rz).translate(0,ly+0.15,zr), railM); api.add(api.box(L,0.12,0.26).rotate(0,0,rz).translate(0,ly+1.0,zr), railM); for(let k=0;k<10;k++){ const t=(k+0.5)/10; bx(0.14,0.66,0.14, xs+dir*t*run, y0+t*R+sr*0.5+0.62, zr, railM); } cb(L/2,0.6,0.12,0,ly+0.6,zr,rz); } const h=(f+1)*R; const sg = front?1:-1; const lx = sg*(LX0+LX1)/2; bx(LX1-LX0,1.0,6,lx,h-0.5,0,marble); cb((LX1-LX0)/2,0.5,3,lx,h-0.5,0,0); const rx = sg*(LX0+PX)/2, rl = PX-LX0; railX(rx, rl, h, 2.85); if (f<nF-1) railX(rx, rl, h, -2.85); railZ(sg*(PX-0.12), 0, 5.7, h); if (f===nF-1) railZ(sg*(LX0+0.12), 1.5, 2.8, h); } for (let q=0;q<2;q++){ const sg = q===0?1:-1; const H = sg>0?(nF-1)*R:nF*R; const ph = H-1.0+1.5; bx(1.3, ph, 5.4, sg*10.85, -1.5+ph/2, 0, pierM); cb(0.65, ph/2, 2.7, sg*10.85, -1.5+ph/2, 0, 0); } return api.build();

med-house.description: Mediterranean town house: plaster walls with stone quoins, plinth, string courses and cornice; shuttered windows with stone sills, jambs and lintels and glazing bars; a door with surround, hood and step; iron-railed balcony; tiled hip or gable roof with overhanging eaves and chimney, or a flat terrace roof with parapet, stair hut and pergola. Front faces +Z.

temple-grand.description: Classical peripteral temple (built-in classical-temple parts) with fluted columns (bump-mapped flutes with sharp arrises), weathered veined marble, a sculpted pediment group of draped figures (with a central goddess carrying a gilded shield and spear) and large gilded palmette acroteria at the apex and corners, front and back.
temple-grand.source: const P=params;const parts=api.library('classical-temple',{width:P.width,length:P.length,height:P.height,columns:P.columns,variant:P.variant,color:P.color,roofColor:P.roofColor,accentColor:P.goldColor});let minX=1e9,minY=1e9,minZ=1e9,maxX=-1e9,maxY=-1e9,maxZ=-1e9;let rMinY=1e9,rMinX=1e9,rMaxX=-1e9,rMinZ=1e9,rMaxZ=-1e9;const rc=String(P.roofColor).toLowerCase();const gc=String(P.goldColor).toLowerCase();for(const p of parts){const b=p.mesh.bounds();minX=Math.min(minX,b.min[0]);minY=Math.min(minY,b.min[1]);minZ=Math.min(minZ,b.min[2]);maxX=Math.max(maxX,b.max[0]);maxY=Math.max(maxY,b.max[1]);maxZ=Math.max(maxZ,b.max[2]);const c=(p.material&&p.material.color)?String(p.material.color).toLowerCase():'';if(c===rc){rMinY=Math.min(rMinY,b.min[1]);rMinX=Math.min(rMinX,b.min[0]);rMaxX=Math.max(rMaxX,b.max[0]);rMinZ=Math.min(rMinZ,b.min[2]);rMaxZ=Math.max(rMaxZ,b.max[2]);}}const H=maxY-minY;const hasRoof=rMinY<1e8&&rMinY>minY+0.5*H;const ye=hasRoof?rMinY:maxY-0.13*H;const cx=hasRoof?(rMinX+rMaxX)/2:(minX+maxX)/2;const halfTop=hasRoof?(rMaxX-rMinX)/2:(maxX-minX)/2-0.4;const zTop=hasRoof?rMaxZ:maxZ-0.8;const zBack=hasRoof?rMinZ:minZ+0.8;const relE=ye-minY;const a0=0.09*H,a1=0.115*H,c1=relE-0.15*H,c0=c1-0.03*H;const bump='0.03*(1-abs(n.y))*smoothstep('+a0.toFixed(2)+','+a1.toFixed(2)+',o.y)*(1-smoothstep('+c0.toFixed(2)+','+c1.toFixed(2)+',o.y))*(abs(n.z)*(1-abs(sin(o.x*12.6)))+abs(n.x)*(1-abs(sin(o.z*12.6))))';for(const p of parts){const m={};for(const k in p.material){m[k]=p.material[k];}const c=m.color?String(m.color).toLowerCase():'';if(c!==gc){m.surface={layers:[{kind:'veins',amount:0.12,scale:0.6},{kind:'grime',amount:0.3},{kind:'streaks',amount:0.2},{kind:'edgeWear',amount:0.5}]};m.shader={bump:bump};}api.add(p.mesh,m);}const marble={finish:'marble',color:P.color,roughness:0.5,surface:{layers:[{kind:'grime',amount:0.4},{kind:'edgeWear',amount:0.5}]}};const gold={color:P.goldColor,metalness:0.85,roughness:0.3,emissive:P.goldColor,emissiveIntensity:0.25};function put(cur,m){return cur?cur.merge(m):m;}let fig=null,gl=null,bases=null;const zf=zTop-0.6;const hw=halfTop-1.0;const baseY=ye+0.3;const ph=(maxY-0.5)-baseY;const N=13;for(let i=0;i<N;i++){const t=-1+2*i/(N-1);const x=cx+t*hw*0.9;const s=ph*(1-Math.abs(t)*0.92)-0.1;if(s<0.3){continue;}if(s<1.0){const r=Math.max(0.1,s*0.32);const len=Math.max(2.2*r,Math.min(1.7,hw*1.6/(N-1)));fig=put(fig,api.capsule(r,len).rotate(0,0,90).translate(x,baseY+r,zf));fig=put(fig,api.sphere(r*0.75,1).translate(x+(t<0?-1:1)*len*0.45,baseY+r*1.9,zf));}else{const r=s*0.1;fig=put(fig,api.cone(r*2.3,s*0.5,10).translate(x,baseY+s*0.25,zf));fig=put(fig,api.capsule(r*1.3,s*0.6).translate(x,baseY+s*0.3,zf));fig=put(fig,api.capsule(r*1.5,s*0.3).translate(x,baseY+s*0.68,zf));fig=put(fig,api.sphere(r*1.05,1).translate(x,baseY+s*0.9,zf));const dir=t<0?1:-1;const up=(i%3===0);fig=put(fig,api.tube([[x+dir*r*1.3,baseY+s*0.78,zf],[x+dir*s*0.26,baseY+s*(up?0.95:0.52),zf+0.06]],r*0.42,6));fig=put(fig,api.tube([[x-dir*r*1.3,baseY+s*0.78,zf],[x-dir*s*0.18,baseY+s*0.5,zf+0.06]],r*0.42,6));if(i===(N-1)/2){gl=put(gl,api.cylinder(s*0.17,s*0.17,0.08,20).rotate(90,0,0).translate(x-s*0.24,baseY+s*0.45,zf+0.2));fig=put(fig,api.tube([[x+s*0.2,baseY+0.05,zf+0.1],[x+s*0.2,baseY+s*0.98,zf+0.1]],0.035,6));}}}if(fig){fig.displace(function(x,y,z){return 0.02*api.noise3(x*4,y*4,z*4);});api.add(fig,marble);}function palmette(R){const pts=[[-0.2*R,0]];const n=21;for(let k=0;k<=n;k++){const a=Math.PI*(1-k/n);const lobe=0.7+0.3*Math.abs(Math.cos(a*4.5));pts.push([Math.cos(a)*R*lobe*0.75,0.3*R+Math.sin(a)*R*lobe]);}pts.push([0.2*R,0]);return api.extrude(pts,0.16);}const zs=[zTop-0.3,zBack+0.3];for(let j=0;j<2;j++){const zz=zs[j];gl=put(gl,palmette(1.6).translate(cx,maxY-0.15,zz));bases=put(bases,api.box(0.9,0.5,0.6).translate(cx,maxY-0.2,zz));for(let q=0;q<2;q++){const sx=q===0?-1:1;gl=put(gl,palmette(1.0).translate(cx+sx*(halfTop-0.5),ye+0.45,zz));bases=put(bases,api.box(0.8,0.9,0.7).translate(cx+sx*(halfTop-0.5),ye+0.1,zz));}}api.add(bases,marble);if(gl){api.add(gl,gold);}return api.build();
